{{Top|leg}}
A '''location forbidder''' was a device issued to the "indentured workers" at the [[hyperbaride synthesis plant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Marca/Legends|Marca]]. Worn around the wrist, it prevented worked from entering sensitive areas of the plant through a network of [[Sensor/Legends|sensors]] that triggered a powerful electric shock in the device. The electric shock could be triggered remotely by security personnel as a means of punishment.
